description: This file contains implementations of big number exponentiation functions, including modular exponentiation with Montgomery multiplication, reciprocal-based division, and windowed exponentiation algorithms, primarily for cryptographic use within the BoringSSL library.

classes.name: BN_RECP_CTX
classes.description: Context structure for reciprocal division algorithms, holding divisor, reciprocal, and related parameters.

methods.name: BN_exp
methods.description: Performs exponentiation of big numbers, r = a^p, using square-and-multiply.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation, choosing optimized algorithms based on the modulus.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using Montgomery multiplication, optimized for odd moduli.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont_consttime
methods.description: Performs constant-time modular exponentiation to protect against side-channel attacks.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont_word
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation with a small word base, using Montgomery.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp2_mont
methods.description: Performs simultaneous exponentiation with two bases, using Montgomery multiplication.

methods.name: bn_mod_inverse0_prime_mont_small
methods.description: Calculates modular inverse for prime modulus using Fermat's little theorem.
